title: Normalize package.json to a single root object
impact: Prevents tooling errors and deployment issues.
rationale: Two root objects break JSON consumers and may confuse package managers.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json is valid single JSON object
CI passes with no parsing errors

title: Make Lighthouse CI fail the build on regressions
impact: Improves performance accountability and prevents silent regressions.
rationale: Remove stub so failures surface in CI.
acceptanceCriteria: performance:audit exits non-zero on LH failures
baseline saved and compared in CI

title: Add baseline security headers
rationale: Set CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, and Referrer-Policy via Next config or Vercel.

gitStrategy.prTitle: feat(security): add CSP/HSTS and related headers

acceptanceCriteria: CSP and HSTS present on all routes
No header duplication in Vercel config

title: Initialize Sentry for Next.js
impact: Ensures error reporting in prod and preview.
rationale: Add sentry.client.config.ts and sentry.server.config.ts with DSN and sampling.
testsToRun: trigger test error and observe Sentry

title: Audit or remove dead API routes
rationale: Confirm /api/auraFX and /api/noid handlers exist or adjust rewrites.
acceptanceCriteria: All rewrites map to existing handlers or are removed
